title: FE Additions
description: Fairly Large Mod about Making and Using Energy
body:
FE Additions is a fairly large mod adding machines and generators!
Make your way out of the Steam Age (tier 0.5) into Tier 1, Tier 2, and so on.

Warning! This mod is still in its early development, so bugs may arise!

 

 

Credits: Wire Code by Mrzblj
